emma_finance: FYI invoice 101122 (AcmeCorp) has both LEGACY and PRIVATE platform fee lines for Jan migration overlap.
emma_finance: Invoice extract: INV101122 | Date 2026-01-31 | LineA LEGACY Platform Fee $18,000 | LineB PRIVATE Platform Fee $18,000 | Support: Enterprise | Migration window Jan 9-23
luis_accounting: Per SOW we bill one platform fee per active customer. If a CO specifies single fee during overlap, we should prorate. Need CO reference and go/no-go on issuing a credit memo.
olivia_csm: CO is logged in SFDC as CO-2026-0174. Customer explicitly requested single platform fee; migration start Jan 9, legacy decomm Jan 24. Confirm overlap 15 days.
raj_sales: Confirmed timeline. Customer prefers a credit applied to next invoice not a refund.
billing-bot: Created invoice 101122 at 1765439999, status: issued.
emma_finance: Proposed calculation: platform fee $18,000 for 31 days, overlap 15 days -> credit = 18000 * 15/31 = $8,709.68 -> round to $8,710. Recommend issuing credit memo CM-7991 against PRIVATE line and update invoice note with CO-2026-0174 and BILLING ticket.
luis_accounting: Approve amount but require CO link embedded and ops ticket ID. Also mark credit apply-to-next-invoice. @olivia_csm please confirm ticket.
olivia_csm: Created ticket BILLING-4199. Added SFDC CO-2026-0174 link to invoice notes. Commented customer acceptance and credit preference.
emma_finance: I'll create CM-7991 and set invoice 101122 to 'adjusted'. Will CC AR and Billing Ops after issuance. ETA EOD tomorrow.
luis_accounting: Please tag me on AR update. Closing after memo applied.
